description: Static security regression for every shipped dv-* skill, evaluated with NoneAgent (no agent run, no live org). Each test passes a raw SKILL.md via context_document to the SkillSecurityEvaluator, which scores credential safety, destructive-operation guardrails, injection and instruction integrity, and least-privilege and scope on a 1-5 scale (threshold 3). Current (v1.9.0) tests reference the live shipped skill in the checkout; v1.6.0 tests reference frozen snapshots so a security regression is caught at PR time.
